findings.fact: Manual workflow used HF_TOKEN to DELETE an existing Hugging Face Space and create another without a per-run approval gate.
Caller-controlled model_name was interpolated into shell commands while HF_TOKEN was available; model upload had no explicit per-run approval or slug validation.
findings.proposed: Require confirm_external_change=YES, validate a strict slug, pass through environment variables, quote paths and disable checkout credential persistence.

findings.fact: Duplicate model upload workflow had the same unvalidated shell interpolation and token exposure.
findings.proposed: Apply the same confirmation and input-validation controls.

findings.fact: Manual workflow could factory-restart a Hugging Face Space using HF_TOKEN without confirmation.
findings.proposed: Require explicit YES, fail on HTTP errors and grant no GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.

findings.fact: Caller-supplied dataset was passed to a Groq-backed resolver using GROQ_API_KEY; workflow pushed generated results to main without data classification or a least-privilege adapter.
findings.proposed: Disable pending adapter, provenance and data-classification review.

findings.fact: Push-to-main changes under a2a triggered Cloudflare deployment and Worker-secret uploads without per-run approval.
findings.proposed: Remove push trigger, require explicit YES, use contents:read and persist-credentials:false.

findings.fact: Push-to-main triggered Hugging Face Space deployment and could propagate BRAIN_SHARED_SECRET without explicit approval.
findings.proposed: Remove push trigger, require explicit YES, use contents:read and stop automatic shared-secret propagation.

findings.fact: Workflow exposed GROQ_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY and CHATGPT_TOKEN to an unverified allocator; it had contents:write and pull-requests:write and pushed allocation output to main.
findings.proposed: Disable until all nine platform adapters, permissions and data flows are tested.

findings.fact: Manual workflow force-pushed hf_space/ to a Hugging Face Space using HF_TOKEN, with no confirmation gate.
findings.proposed: Disable until a reviewed non-force deployment design exists.

findings.fact: Workflow accepted a Databricks PAT as workflow input, interpolated it into a shell command for gh secret set, then triggered a deployment; no confirmation gate or safe input handling.
findings.proposed: Disable until a secure secret-rotation flow with protected review and environment-based input is designed.

findings.fact: Manual workflow granted contents:write and pull-requests:write, exposed GROQ_API_KEY, ran self-upgrade code and could push an audit artifact to the dispatched ref including main.
findings.proposed: Disable until branch-only execution, diff review and explicit authorization are enforced.

findings.fact: Existing test module already covers manual/YES-gated Barrot Ops, Databricks Deploy, Hugging Face Sync and Databricks Bundle workflows.
findings.proposed: Extend the same CI-listed test module to cover the newly gated and disabled workflows.

source_pr.limitation: Source PR is based on an older main snapshot; its exact-head CI does not validate this fresh-main successor.

limitations: YES input gates are per-run operator confirmations, not protected GitHub Environment reviewer approvals.
The Hugging Face model upload and Cloudflare deploy workflows remain capable of external changes when an authorized dispatcher selects YES; no such dispatch was performed.
Disabled workflows are not deleted; their underlying scripts remain for separate review.
Other active external workflows outside this scope remain to be audited; this PR does not claim all repository workflows are safe.
No provider tokens or repository secrets were read.
next_actions: Create a draft PR against main.
Verify exact-head CI and fail-closed gate and inspect logs.
Audit remaining active workflow files for external mutation and broad write permissions.
Keep all changes unmerged until explicit approval.
